description: Run A: fresh spline-CLT on GPT-2 small at 1B tokens with grid refinement DISABLED (update_grid_every=0) to stop the spline-contribution collapse, and a FIXED held-out validation set (collected once on chunk 0 via the existing chunked path, frozen thereafter). New variant_name + run_name so it starts at ci=0 (the prior spline_fm_gpt2_small_1b/seed_101 run has chunk_index=190 and would otherwise resume). Isolated train/val cache dirs (gpt2_2b_v2) so chunk-0 fixed-val collection cannot clobber the original run's shared val. total_steps unchanged at 58000; shorten separately if desired. Pair against the matched linear baseline at report time.
